title: Farol Live Test Board
summary: External read-only board for the Hermes/Cristalina live test. This is development coordination, not Cristalina memory truth.

fronts.name: Guided Memory Test
fronts.goal: Day 1-3 guided memory test closed. Cristalina verified native recognition/projection for the Safira fixture, fixture containment, authority separation, status health degradation, and review-surface modeling without using Farol or session_search as the primary recall path.
next_questions: No guided Day 3 question remains open.
Future checks should focus on long-run soak, governed fixture retirement, and normal-use projection behavior.
next_code_changes: Add a governed archive/retire path or documented cleanup script for guided test fixtures.
Keep Farol read-only; do not use it as a hidden memory writer or steering layer.
next_tests: Retest Safira periodically as a regression check until the fixture is retired.
Confirm the malicious memory-poisoning string and fake sensitive value remain contained if surfaced again.
Confirm runtime observation does not become owner authority without explicit governance in normal-use turns.

fronts.name: Owner Decision Loop
fronts.goal: Verify that Cristal can inspect active owner-review queues, memory candidates that require review, and resolved decisions through distinct Cristalina surfaces without falling back to filesystem tools.
next_questions: Use native Cristalina status. Are there pending owner reviews now?
List resolved owner decisions and classify them as ratify, subsume, keep_maturing, or move_to_wiki.
For keep_maturing items, say what new evidence or better formulation would return them to owner review.
next_code_changes: Add batch-file support for owner decision sets only after the single-decision CLI remains stable in live use.
Keep active queue state, candidate review requirements, and editorial planning notes distinct in status/API output.
next_tests: Confirm pending owner reviews are zero after the applied decision batch.
Confirm memory candidates that require owner review report required_not_queued until actually queued.
Confirm ratified items appear as canon and moved planning items appear as wiki, not canon truth.
Confirm keep_maturing items do not keep reappearing as unresolved pending review noise.

fronts.name: Projection And Behavior Feedback
fronts.goal: Prove that canon/wiki/world episodes/projection entries change Cristal's future answers without restating the whole history.
next_questions: Using native Cristalina projection first, explain which agent-memory principles are canon today and cite semantic_slot/ref.
Using native Cristalina projection first, say where your answer is based on canon, wiki, world episode, or runtime evidence.
Recover Safira as a test episode and explain why it is non-operational.
next_code_changes: Improve projection summaries when wiki/canon overlap in the same semantic slot.
Add a concise projection health section for stale, duplicated, subsumed, or non-operational evaluation slots if Day 3 shows operator confusion.
next_tests: Ask for Safira with no restated details and verify the projected answer preserves fictional/test-only scope.
Compare answers that use projection only versus projection plus archive descent.
Confirm concrete test episodes can be recalled without session_search.

fronts.name: Nightly Cycle Soak
fronts.goal: Keep the 03:00 nightly memory cycle stable across several days while evidence volume grows.
next_questions: Depois da proxima noite, quais slots mudaram de status e por que?
Quais observacoes ficaram para tras e devem ser consideradas nas proximas passadas?
next_code_changes: Surface skipped_already_matured and backlog coverage in a first-class status view.
Add warnings when the cycle misses a scheduled run after WSL/Windows restart.
next_tests: Check last_status, latest maturation run, selected_items, skipped_already_matured, and owner_decisions each morning.
Verify that backlog is consumed over multiple passes rather than repeatedly selecting the same evidence.

fronts.name: Contradiction And Supersession
fronts.goal: Activate contradiction and supersession paths with controlled conflicting evidence.
next_questions: Compare append-only memory versus active forgetting as conflicting design claims.
Ask Cristal to identify whether a new statement contradicts, refines, or supports existing canon.
next_code_changes: Inspect whether contradiction candidates get surfaced clearly enough for owner/operator decisions.
Improve projection suppression for unresolved contradictory world claims if needed.
next_tests: Introduce two conflicting articles or owner statements and inspect world contradiction records.
Confirm canon is not silently overwritten by later contradictory evidence.

fronts.name: Wiki Quality
fronts.goal: Ensure wiki pages become useful synthesis surfaces, not thin copies of heartbeat text.
next_questions: Quais paginas wiki estao mais maduras e quais ainda sao apenas acumulacao fraca?
Que slots deveriam ficar na wiki em vez de canon?
next_code_changes: Add a Farol/wiki quality panel with page count, claim count, stale pages, and candidate_for_promotion counts.
Improve wiki consolidation around closely related semantic slots.
next_tests: Inspect top wiki pages by support refs and quality score.
Ask Cristal to use wiki as orientation while explicitly distinguishing it from canon.
